definition: Something considered and deliberately left out, with its reason stated beside it, such as a diagram the composer weighed and did not offer. It is drawn in lines rising to the right, lighter and more widely spaced than the forbidden mark.
basis: workbench/app/src/theme/tokens.css, the duty block's comment on this mark: "Set aside: lines rising to the right, for something considered and deliberately left out, with its reason beside it." and on the forbidden mark it must not be read as: "Forbidden: close rising lines over the variant a style's kit rules out, its name struck through." The block states the rule every mark keeps: "Each duty token below means one thing wherever it is drawn".
